items.title: My Chemical Romance Tease New Album, Bring Out King Diamond
items.summary: My Chemical Romance effectively broke up in 2013 before reuniting in 2019. In recent years, they've been touring stadiums and playing their 2006 classic The Black Parade in full, as well as other assorted tracks. They haven't released any new music since reuniting, and their most recent studio album is Danger Days , their 2010 Black Parade follow-up. But now, they're finally talking about making new music. The post My Chemical Romance Tease New Album, Bring Out King Diamond appeared first on Stereogum .

items.title: Macklemore dropped from Ed Sheeran’s US tour after ‘free Palestine’ speech
items.summary: The American rapper will no longer support Sheeran’s US leg of Loop tour after comments at MetLife Stadium show Macklemore has been dropped from the remainder of the US leg of Ed Sheeran ’s Loop tour, after the American rapper drew headlines for saying “free Palestine” on stage at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey. In a brief speech between songs on 4 September, the Grammy-winning artist told the audience he wanted the people of Gaza and “the occupied West Bank” to know “we have not forgotten about them”, prompting a petition from the Israeli American Council demanding his removal from the tour.
